title: personal-llm-inference-mini-tracker-q1-2026
content:
Personal LLM inference mini-tracker (working sheet)
Owner: Avery Chen
Purpose: quick personal log of small experiments for batching/quantization/latency tradeoffs. Intended to be informal - notes to self, TODOs, links to tickets/PRs.

Columns: id,date,model,model_variant,quantization,batch_size,seq_len,avg_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,tokens_in,tokens_out,cost_est_usd,notes,status

1,2026-01-20,openlm-7b,baseline,float32,1,128,85,120,45,205,0.012,baseline single-request perf,draft
2,2026-01-22,openlm-7b,quantized-4bit,q4_0,1,128,52,78,45,205,0.006,4-bit speedup but minor output jitter,draft
3,2026-01-26,redwood-open-7b,qat-8bit,q8,4,128,40,65,45,210,0.005,batching x4 decent p95, check memory pressure,draft
4,2026-01-30,redwood-open-7b,quantized-4bit,q4_0,8,64,28,45,22,110,0.004,batch 8 lower latency for short seq, try larger seq,draft
5,2026-02-07,redwood-open-7b,kv-cache-test,float16,1,512,260,330,180,720,0.030,kv-cache warmup matters a lot, p95 spikes when cold,draft
6,2026-02-18,redwood-open-7b,quantized-4bit,q4_0,2,256,95,130,90,410,0.011,repeat with different kernel selection, link to PR 412,draft

Notes to self:
- Need to add column for "kernel_variant" (cuBLAS vs custom) - affects p95 for q4_0.
- Follow up with Jordan on GPU memory tuning (JIRA-ML-812).
- Add small eval prompts to detect quality regressions for q4_0 vs float32.
- Consider adding rolling-average latency column and chart in perf-summaries.

Quick TODOs:
- [ ] Push a small harness to reproduce row 2 vs row 6 variance (script: perf/bench/run_minis.sh)
- [ ] Add links to raw logs (gs://redwood-perf/avery/2026/q1)
- [ ] Move finalized rows into confluence/perf-kpis-2026 when stable

Scratch bits / thoughts:
- Observed that batch=8 with seq_len=64 often gives better tail latency than batch=4 with seq_len=128 - likely queueing effect; need load-profile test.
- For private deployments we might prefer q8 quant for regulatory workloads (determinism) even if cost is slightly higher.
- Question: how to include model rollout tags? (can tie to route-config in console)

Linked quick references:
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- JIRA: JIRA-ML-812 (gpu-mem-tuning)
- Confluence perf page: confluence:perf-kpis-2026

End of mini-sheet (working)
